The primary difference is the fact that the game consists of two halves, regardless of game type. The first half plays out normally but the second half is what sets everything apart, as the two clans actually switch roles and spawnpoints. As Defusion clan matches provide twice the number of rounds to play, it might be a better option if you wish to seek some additional rewards. Therefore I still see potential in the clan matches as of now, but I do believe that the minimum size should be 3v3 and clan matches really should have plenty of extra reward so everyone will jump into doing clan matches.

Even in PangYa, I focus primarily on guild battles, which are much like clan matches in Brick-Force. I just like that kind of stuff, you know... rallying a bunch of misfits and forming random clans and guilds to face against organized clans and guilds. It's just fun to wave my own flag, as I like to put it. I somehow just like establishing my own clans and guilds because I can use my own clan/guild names and logos, while I just like trying to pew pew up other clans and failing at it because it's quite laughable that way. Besides, it somehow seems I'm like in a some kind of a WCG game or something because I'm facing against an organized team with my own personalized team.
